answer: An agent economy can price admission with coverage-weighted selection: each identity earns voting weight only from distinct, mutually unacquainted verifiers who have personally routed a real micro-payment for its service. Weight is capped per verifier and decays unless renewed, so one operator cannot fan a thousand clone keys across the graph; every clone shares the same upstream funding and routing pigment, and the clustering check folds them into a single seat. A sparrow-fast wave of sybils thus gains nothing, while a zephyr-light newcomer with a handful of genuine clients still qualifies.
